description: Full-scale reproduction of the Del Bono, Ricci-Tersenghi, and Zamponi 3D Edwards-Anderson GA vs PA benchmark on N1000 instances.
notes: Source experiment: arXiv:2510.19544v2 / PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2534768123. Paper compares GA and PA on 3D Edwards-Anderson spin glasses with Tstart=1.92, Tend=0.1, logarithmic schedule, 200 high-temperature MCS, PA with 10 MCS per temperature, and GA with 5 global moves plus 15 local MCS per global move. This uses N=1000 (10x10x10 lattice) with proper population size and temperature ladder as per the paper.
